The least modification to negate "I can't use my card because it is not working" while preserving the meaning is:

**"I can use my card because it is working."**

Here's why:

*   **"I can't use my card"** negates to **"I can use my card"**.
*   **"it is not working"** negates to **"it is working"**.

The resulting sentence maintains a logical cause-and-effect connection with the opposite meaning.
